languageSelect.title: Learn with a safe practice
languageSelect.body: Nothing here is real money. Choose the language that feels easiest.

intro.title: A practice with virtual money
intro.body: Nothing is real. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere.

setup.title: A forwarded message makes a promise
setup.body: A message says borrowed exposure can double money in a week. This is a teaching example, not advice.

prediction.title: What do you think will happen?
prediction.body: There is no right answer. Choose what you expect.

run.title: Watch the same path unfold
run.body: A teaching rule can close the position early. You can exit at any pause.
run.exitedChoice: You chose to exit on this bar.

result.title: The leveraged position
result.body: These numbers come from the teaching engine on the same hidden path.
result.forcedExitLine: The teaching rule closed this position early.
result.survivedLine: This position stayed open to the end.
result.userExitLine: This position was closed by your choice.

replay.title: Now see it without leverage
replay.body: Both lines replay the identical path. Only the borrowed exposure differs.
replay.requiredGain: To return to the starting amount after this loss needs a {gain} gain — the maths is not symmetrical.
replay.requiredGainNone: This run did not end below its starting amount, so no recovery maths is shown.

reveal.title: The period behind this episode
reveal.body: One episode never predicts the future.
reveal.placeholderNote: This episode is a clearly labelled synthetic placeholder. Real history arrives only after a human verifies its source and licence.
reveal.oneEpisode: One episode is a teaching example. It is not a forecast, and it does not describe any real instrument.

debrief.title: What the practice explains
debrief.body: Each point below comes from the numbers you just saw.
debrief.recoveryInterpolated: Ending at {finalAmount} after starting from {startAmount} would need a {gain} gain to return to the start.

postCheck.title: What do you think now?
postCheck.body: The second answer is for your reflection, not a score.
postCheck.wouldTake: Would you take this position now?
postCheck.changed: You chose {before} before and {after} now. Noticing a change is the point of this step; there is no score.
postCheck.unchanged: Your answer stayed the same. That is also worth noticing; there is no score.

nextSteps.title: No recommendations here
nextSteps.body: Verified protective resources will appear here when a human checks them. None are published yet.
nextSteps.empty: TODO(human): add verified protective resources before release
